geography_weight: ABS 2021 resident population within the selected plan's published postcodes, excluding flagged or unmatched postal areas
assistance_weight: 1 + (10 - area IRSD decile) / 9 + 10 * min(area JobSeeker count / area population, 0.2)
joint_structure: Assumed, not fitted: weighted assistance selection without replacement; independent life-support and historical disconnection markers; exponential positive current-debt shape rescaled to the published mean; independent debt-entry calibration cohort
consumption_assignment: Uniform deterministic sampling from 299 complete Ausgrid GC household-year profiles. The original 300-home source is not representative and the one incomplete profile is excluded without imputation.
seasonality_assignment: Each account references its region's AEMO operational-demand and BOM temperature context. Observed system/city context remains separate from Ausgrid household month factors; no causal or blended customer factor is asserted.
tariff_eligibility: Synthetic accounts are assumed to have an applicable single-rate network tariff in the plan's postcode service area. No eligibility or bill calculation for any real account.
scope: Two illustrative distributor footprints, calibrated to state-level rates; neither a state-representative nor an AGL customer sample
unmeasured: Victorian life-support prevalence is absent from the selected ESC workbook; stored as null rather than borrowing the AER rate
Current assistance-debt distribution and individual postcode/assistance relationships are generated assumptions
Victorian household consumption is not observed; the NSW Ausgrid library is used only as an explicitly labelled shape prior
AEMO demand and BOM temperature are contextual series and do not establish a household-level causal relationship
Synthetic breach cases cover six eligible obligations and do not estimate real-world breach prevalence
